title: Beta channel scaffold — hivemind-beta plugin identity
description: Stand up the side-by-side BETA plugin on the `beta` branch so users can install it alongside stable v0.6.0 and try experimental loop-engineering features with zero risk to their stable install. Claude Code namespaces commands/skills by plugin NAME, so the beta needs a distinct plugin identity. This ticket ONLY does the identity/packaging scaffold (no loop features yet — those are TASK-061/062). Scope is the `beta` branch; `main` stays untouched.
acceptance_criteria: .claude-plugin/plugin.json on beta: name = 'hivemind-beta', version = '0.7.0-beta.1' (prerelease). mcpServers ref unchanged.

publish-config.spec.js (and any other name/version pin) updated for the beta: EXPECTED_PLUGIN_NAME = 'hivemind-beta', EXPECTED_VERSION = '0.7.0-beta.1'; SEMVER_RE relaxed to accept an optional prerelease suffix (e.g. /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/) so the prerelease version validates. EXPECTED_MARKETPLACE_NAME stays 'hivemind-marketplace'.

.claude-plugin/marketplace.json on beta lists the hivemind-beta plugin (source './') so `claude plugin validate .` passes ON the beta branch. (The opt-in entry on MAIN's marketplace that points at ref:beta is a separate main-branch change, NOT part of this beta-branch ticket.)

Any plugin-scaffold/parity test that hard-codes the plugin name is updated minimally for the beta identity; the full suite passes on beta (npm run test:all — this touches packaging/config + test constants, so the release-tier gate applies).
`claude plugin validate .` PASSES on the beta branch.
dist/ is rebuilt if any bundled source changed (likely none here, but run npm run build:plugin if plugin name leaks into a bundle) and committed; dist-parity green.
